endpoint: For each positive concentration and readout, take replicate means at each DIV, then the mean over DIV 5/7/9/12. At least one absolute mean >=3 means full-series assay activity. Missing readout/DIV entries contribute zero, with their mask retained. This is an operational assay activity endpoint, not a clinical hazard label.
reason: The risk-qualified fixed baseline already releases every held-out chemical. No candidate can have a positive release-coverage difference on this endpoint and budget.
ablations: Not run: the prespecified minimum-probe stop rule was reached.
